blurb: Cross Timbers Golf Course is an 18-hole, par-72 course designed by Jeffery Brauer, opened in 1995. It features Champion Bermuda greens, undulating fairways, natural hazards, strategic bunkering, and elevation changes that create a hill country feel. The course is located next to Ash Creek in the Cross Timbers area of north Texas and is a favorite of locals and visitors from the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
